correctness.rationale: Spherical Gaussian normalization produces symmetric Dirichlet coordinates with parameter 1/2. Exact mixed beta moments give the stated covariance. The telescoping identity F_z=a sum_{k=0}^{m-1}(z+a)_k/(z+1)_k has strictly decreasing summands for a>1 and strictly increasing summands for 0<a<1; hence F_alpha-F_{d alpha} has exactly the sign a-1 for d>=2. Fourth-power formula and dimension-three examples follow algebraically. Independently implemented Dirichlet-moment, circular-quadrature and Gaussian sampling consistency checks: 1,478 passed. Numerical tests are supplementary.

value.rationale: An all-dimensional, all-real-first-exponent sign classification for joint directional projection-width energies of geometrically distinct dual norm balls, with a sharp Euclidean boundary, exact covariance magnitude, explicit dimension-three example, and a more general symmetric-Dirichlet result. Deterministic norm orders can conflict, so the systematic sign is a genuine distributional dependence phenomenon, not a tautological pointwise order.
